ABS Outstanding : The survey was performed remotely based on information provided by the vessel’s manager and master.
The ABS Global Operation Center was approached by the vessel’s manager to verify and report Malfunctioned No.1 VHF via ABS remote survey platform.
As per Singapore Flag administration Circular No.10 of 2025, the survey was carried out remotely.
Vessel's master reported SIO error alarm appeared several times on No.1VHF on 30 July 2026. When alarm appeared, No.1 VHF became unfunctional and work abnormal.
 Following actions were taken for safe voyage:
1.Officers On Watch re-started the power of No.1 VHF which became normal communication, but the issue was not resolved completely, sometime later it appeared again.
2.Risk Assessment was carried out, and mitigation measures were implemented on board.
3.All related crew were trained/alerted on subject damage.
4.Shore technician will be arranged to attend ship to fix the No.1 VHF problem at following available ports, subject to ship’s berthing schedule as per ship manager’s email dated 31 July 2026.
As vessel was at sea, and shore service was not available, the manager requested a condition to allow them to repair the affected VH1 No.1.
The Remote Survey was carried out by reviewing the submitted documents as follows:
1.Master’s Attestation.
2.Master’s license
3.Risk Assessment and Mitigation Plan
4.Crew Training record
5. Deck Logbook record
6. Photos
7. Ship manager’s email dated 31 July 2026
8.  Singapore Flag circular 10 of 2025
Upon completion of reviewing provided supporting documentations, as per Singapore Flag’s circular, the statutory condition was created with due date 10 September 2026 and a short-term Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate valid till 10 September 2026 was issued at this time subject to following,
1. Risk assessment was carried out as per the ISM company’s safety management system and implemented on board the ship.
2 The Master shall notify the relevant competent authority as required by regulation of MARPOL Annex VI when the ship is calling to a port.
